archetype: THE PRECISION PRACTITIONER (Swiss High-Contrast meets Traditional British Accounting Chamber)
emotional_tone: Utilitarian, trustworthy, uncluttered, surgical precision, calm command-center
theme: Light mode primary (deep crisp navy sidebar + porcelain off-white canvas + pure white cards + surgical red alert accent)
design_principles: Utilitarian first: No decorative clutter, no bloated AI animations, every pixel serves workflow efficiency
Navy Authority & Red Alert: LedgerFlow deep navy (#0B1E3F) anchors structure and primary actions; vibrant red (#DC2626) is strictly reserved for overdue & critical SLA violations
Dense Quiet Tables: Accounting-grade dense tabular grids with micro-caps uppercase headers, crisp borders, and subtle row hover transitions
Instant State Clarity: Status pills (Pending, In Progress, Completed, Hold, Overdue) with unmistakable muted tints and high-contrast text
Tactile Direct Manipulation: Inline status transitions, quick mark-complete actions, and modal fast-drawers

typography.font_family_recommendation: Instrument Sans, Manrope, or Geist (Google Fonts embed / clean sans-serif stack)

hierarchy.h1_page_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight

status_badges.overdue: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 hover:bg-red-100 font-semibold

layout_and_spacing.structure: Fixed left sidebar (w-64) + Top header (h-16) + Main fluid scrollable content area (max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 py-6)

elements: Current live Practice Date display (e.g. Wednesday, July 15, 2026)
Search bar for fast client or task lookup
Quick Action: 'Generate Today's Work' button (subtle navy/blue outline)
Primary Action: '+ New Task' button (solid LedgerFlow Navy #0B1E3F)

grid_modes.kpi_row: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 sm:gap-4 mb-6

StatCard.purpose: Show immediate operational counts on Morning Cockpit
StatCard.classes: p-4 rounded-lg border transition-all duration-150 hover:shadow-sm cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden

OverdueTable.purpose: Highlight urgent and SLA-breached tasks immediately in Cockpit
OverdueTable.empty_state: All tasks are on track. No overdue items.

TasksOnHoldTable.purpose: Display blocked items requiring partner/client attention

TodaysWorkView.purpose: Comprehensive task workbench for staff & practice partner
filters: Status filter tabs (All, Pending, In Progress, Completed, Hold)
Priority filter (All, Critical, High, Medium, Low)
actions: Generate Today's Work (creates daily/weekly/monthly instances for today from active Recurring Rules)
Add Remarks modal / inline editable field

ClientMaster.purpose: Central directory of business & individual clients

RecurringRulesMaster.purpose: Automated recurring compliance engine rules (GST, TDS, Payroll, VAT, Monthly Closure, Bank Reco)

StaffMaster.purpose: Manage accounting practice staff members and initials for avatar badge assignment
fields: Role (Partner, Senior Accountant, Junior Auditor, Bookkeeper)

mock_and_persistence_strategy.start_state: Empty initial state as requested ('Start empty (no seed data)'), BUT provide a clear, non-intrusive 'Load Practice Demo Data' option or guided empty states so users can test immediately with 1 click if desired, without forcing it.

fields: Day of Period (e.g. Day 5 or Every Monday)
Reason for Hold (e.g. Awaiting Bank Statement from Client, Query pending with tax dept)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the LedgerFlow Navy (#0B1E3F) aesthetic with red accent (#DC2626) ONLY for overdue and critical alert badges.
Implement the 4 core routes/tabs cleanly: 1) Morning Cockpit (Dashboard), 2) Today's Work, 3) Client Master, 4) Recurring Task Rules. Include Staff Master inline or as a modal/sub-panel.
Implement the 'Generate Today's Work' button: it checks active recurring rules, checks if a task for today already exists, and spawns today's task instances with a satisfying toast notification.
Keep tables dense, quiet, high-contrast, with uppercase micro-headers (`text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500`).
Use Lucide icons exclusively (e.g., ClipboardList, CheckCircle2, Clock, AlertTriangle, PauseCircle, Users, Repeat, Plus, Filter, Search, ArrowRight). No AI assistant emojis.
Make sure all modals and dialogs have solid, crisp backgrounds (`bg-white`), never transparent.
Provide clear, useful empty states when starting fresh, plus a subtle 'Load Sample Practice Data' button on the empty state banner to let the reviewer inspect rich data instantly if needed.
Add all requested data-testid attributes to allow end-to-end automated testing.
